item.title: What’s it Like to Run Move-In Weekend?
item.dc:creator: Charley Tamagno
item.description:
The McGill Daily · Charley Tamagno · Aug 31 · 8:39 a.m.
As the school year is set in motion, first years, returning undergrads, and graduate students alike flood McGill’s residences on move-in day. Behind the scenes are current McGill students known as Residence Life Facilitators (RLFs) who facilitate move-in and residence life. The Daily interviewed two RLFs who currently work at New Residence Hall (NRH) to discuss managing the stress of moving in.

item.title: The Death of Futurity
item.dc:creator: Anneke Goodwin
item.description:

item.title: Keep the Planet in Mind During Move-in
item.dc:creator: The editorial team
item.description:
The McGill Daily · The editorial team · Aug 31 · 8:00 a.m.
The truth is that stopping the move-out mass littering begins at move-in. The reality for many McGill students is that we are temporary residents in Montreal, and many of us will leave the city after graduation. As much as departure seems far away upon arrival, we must remember that many of our possessions will not come with us when we leave.

item.title: Into the Editing Room
item.dc:creator: Sarah Toman
item.description:
The McGill Daily · Sarah Toman · Aug 31 · 8:00 a.m.
Not only did the juvenile, shallow writing provide an unpleasant reading experience, but it demonstrated the amount of effort that the author put into the development of the protagonists’ bond. On page 33, AJ describes Noah’s eyes as “not ugly” when they change colour in the sun. The lack of effort put into this line irritated me so much that I had to close the book and take a deep breath.

item.title: You have the best taste in music, as long as it’s yours
item.dc:creator: Kaitlyn Schramm
item.description:
The Tribune · Kaitlyn Schramm · Aug 30 · 1:15 p.m.
I was probably the most obnoxious 12-year-old to exist. I listened to 3WK Undergroundradio and looked down upon my friends whose Liked Songs on Spotify spanned the short distance from Juice WRLD to XXXTENTACION . Instead, I was passionate about jazz piano. I would sooner listen to 10 minutes of pots and pans clanging together against an ambient backdrop than turn on the latest Taylor Swift album.

item.title: Quebec must address its homelessness crisis through preventative, not punitive, measures
item.dc:creator: Mishel Bilak
item.description:
The Tribune · Mishel Bilak · Aug 30 · 1:08 p.m.
While current treatment-focused institutions in Quebec, such as shelters and warming centres , do connect vulnerable people with access to sanctuary and healthcare, they consistently function at full capacity , forcing individuals to search for refuge in public spaces such as metro stations . This pattern reflects how such strategies are unable to wholly effectively combat homelessness.

item.title: Célébrer l’Ukraine, même à plus de 6 500 km
item.dc:creator: Charles Pinel
item.description:
La Pige · Charles Pinel · 24 août · 16 h 52
Depuis 1991, l’Ukraine fête son indépendance le 24 août, jour où la Déclaration d’indépendance du pays a été adoptée. Alors que la guerre contre la Russie fait toujours rage dans leur pays d’origine, bon nombre d’Ukrainiens maintenant installés au Saguenay—Lac-Saint-Jean ont célébré cette journée à leur façon cette fin de semaine.
